articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process video streams, audio, and codebases in a single context window of up to 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant gains on software engineering benchmarks, scoring 78% on SWE-Bench Verified, and introduces real-time streaming tool use. This positions it as a serious contender for autonomous coding and multimedia analysis workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which solved 88% of International Mathematical Olympiad problems in formal proof format, surpassing all prior AI systems. The model uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that generates candidate proofs and formally validates them using Lean 4 integration. Researchers say this marks a turning point for AI-assisted formal verification in both mathematics and safety-critical software.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure Robotics announced the first large-scale commercial deployment of its Figure 03 humanoid robots at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina manufacturing plant, with 200 units performing complex assembly and logistics tasks. The robots operate alongside human workers with a new collaborative safety framework certified by TÜV SÜD. BMW reports a 31% improvement in throughput in pilot assembly lines, signaling a potential inflection point for humanoid adoption in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics showcased its fully electric Atlas robot completing a DARPA-organized urban disaster response course with no human teleoperation, navigating collapsed structures, opening doors, and carrying 40 kg payloads over rubble. The robot used an on-board vision-language model for real-time scene understanding and task planning. The demonstration has renewed interest from FEMA and military branches in deploying humanoid platforms for search-and-rescue operations.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers 2.0, Dramatically Reducing Jailbreak Success Rates
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional Classifiers 2.0, an updated safety layer for Claude models that reduces jailbreak success rates to under 0.3% across a comprehensive red-team evaluation while preserving helpfulness scores. The system uses a learned constitution derived from adversarial training against over 50,000 novel attack patterns. The approach is being offered as a licensable safety module for other AI labs, signaling a shift toward shared AI safety infrastructure.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has begun at its Fab 20 facility in Hsinchu, roughly one quarter ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers an estimated 20% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, leveraging gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery. Apple and NVIDIA are expected to be the first major customers, with chips taping out for 2027 consumer products.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA clearance for its N2 brain-computer interface device, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and features a fully wireless design with on-chip signal processing. The approval covers expanded clinical trials for patients with quadriplegia and ALS, with three major medical centers now enrolling participants. Early data from the N1 cohort showed patients achieving cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks, generating significant interest from the neuroscience community.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 1.2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a 1.2 trillion parameter mixture-of-experts model with 128 experts and 16 active per token, as a fully open-weight model under a permissive license. Benchmarks show it matching or exceeding GPT-5 on reasoning and code generation tasks while requiring significantly fewer active FLOPs per inference. The release includes optimized serving code for commodity GPU clusters, lowering the barrier for enterprises to run frontier-class models on their own infrastructure.
